description: This file contains authentication and authorization checks for organization-related routes within a FastAPI project. It verifies user roles and memberships, enforces access controls for creating organizations, organization admin routes, and team creation, and provides helper functions for extracting organization info from user objects.

methods.name: organization_role_based_access_check( request_body: dict, user_object: Optional[LiteLLM_UserTable], route: str, )
methods.description: Performs role-based access control checks based on user role, route, and organization memberships.

methods.name: Tuple[List[str],Dict[str,Optional[LitellmUserRoles]]] get_user_organization_info( user_object: LiteLLM_UserTable, )
methods.description: Extracts organization IDs and roles from a user object.

methods.name: bool _user_is_org_admin( request_data: dict, user_object: Optional[LiteLLM_UserTable] = None, )
methods.description: Checks if the user holds an organization admin role for a specified organization.

ctags.signature: ( request_body: dict, user_object: Optional[LiteLLM_UserTable], route: str, )
